errors.text_span: като секторът „1 Силно съгласен“ е визуално подчертан чрез изместване от центъра на диаграмата
errors.evidence: The description claims that the largest sector is visually emphasized by being shifted from the center. This is incorrect. The image shows a standard 3D pie chart, and no single sector is exploded or offset for emphasis. The appearance of separation is an artifact of the 3D perspective applied to the entire chart.
